description: The App component renders the Todo list and an input at the top. Pressing Enter adds a Todo and clears the input. Completion-state toggling remains out of scope until F004.
acceptance_criteria: The page renders a top input with the placeholder 'Add a Todo and press Enter' and a list container
On first load, the list shows existing Todos from localStorage in descending createdAt order
Entering text and pressing Enter adds a row at the top of the list and clears the input
Pressing Enter with an empty or whitespace-only value does not add a Todo
Input longer than 200 characters is truncated to the first 200 characters
Todo data persists through the loadTodos and saveTodos functions from F002
